def logarithmic_similarity(a: numbers, b: numbers, threshold: float=0.1):
    distance = logarithmic_distance(a, b)
    if distance < threshold:
        return 1.0
    return max(0.0, 1.0 - distance)


def logarithmic_distance(a: numbers, b: numbers):
    if a == b:
        return 0
    if not isinstance(a, float):
        a = float(a)
    if not isinstance(b, float):
        b = float(b)
    
    abs_a = abs(a) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET
    abs_b = abs(b) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET
    
    log_a = math.copysign(math.log(abs_a), a)
    log_b = math.copysign(math.log(abs_b), b)
    
    return abs(log_a - log_b)
